title: Adding a whole number to the numerator
statement: To add a whole number and a fraction you add the whole number to the numerator.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: add a whole number and a proper fraction
evidence_patterns.signature: adds the whole number to the numerator and keeps the denominator

discriminators.vs_slip: The result is smaller than the whole-number addend and the learner accepts it, consistently. A slip is not repeated across items.

vs.math.frac.mixed-to-improper-add-all: That bug adds all three numbers when converting a mixed number; this one appears when a whole number and fraction are added with a plus sign.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 4.NF.B.3: understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b

resolved_by.label: CCSS 4.NF.B.3: understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b

sources.citation: Ashlock, R. B. (2010). Error Patterns in Computation: Using Error Patterns to Help Each Student Learn (10th ed.). Allyn & Bacon.
Kerslake, D. (1986). Fractions: Children's Strategies and Errors. NFER-Nelson.
Braithwaite, D. W., Pyke, A. A., & Siegler, R. S. (2017). A computational model of fraction arithmetic. Psychological Review, 124(5), 603-625.
